SECCOMP  DISABLED (--no-seccomp) — every syscall below runs UNFILTERED:
           ptrace, bpf, userfaultfd, perf_event_open, add_key, keyctl,
           request_key, pidfd_getfd, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev
         — plus clone3 (ENOSYS), ioctl(_, TIOCSTI, _), and
         clone/unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER). The namespace boundary is
         unaffected; this is defence in depth, not the boundary.
